rule: Every cross-organization learning signal must be anonymized, aggregated, permissioned, and explainable before it improves another tenant.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, booking commission, or payment-custody signal can enter shared learning or affect phase-one recommendations.
boundary_principles: Keep organization-private memory inside the tenant boundary.
Share only anonymized aggregate category, proof, response, and market patterns.
Explain the purpose, route, audience, and anonymization state before network learning is used.
Require human approval before learned behavior changes an operational buyer, supplier, or founder action.
Keep rollback notes for every shared learning policy.
Block rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, booking commission, and payment-custody signals from shared learning.
